newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Feb currency reserves rise to $18.275 bln.
newsitem.headline: Polish Feb currency reserves rise to $18.275 bln.

text.p: Polish official foreign currency reserves grew by $60 million in February to $18.275 billion and were $1.26 billion higher than a year ago, the National Bank of Poland said.
It said official reserves grew $240 million in the January-February period compared to a $2.04 billion rise in the corresponding period of last year.
POLISH RESERVES (bln dollars) FEB 97 JAN 97 FEB 96
NOTE - Figures in billions of dollars. Official reserves are those held by the state. Net reserves mean the total amount of hard currencies in the whole banking system.
